title: The Graded Cellar
objective: Search the old cellar for what was buried in it, and get out alive. Leave by the steps when you are ready.

rooms.name: Cellar Steps
rooms.description: Worn steps lead down from a trapdoor into a cellar. Half the far wall has fallen in.

features.name: Rubble Heap
features.description: A heap of fallen stone and rotten beams against the far wall.
features.discovery: Pinned under a beam is a crushed lantern, its glass still warm: someone was here not long ago.

failure-by-5.text: The heap shifts as you dig, and stones crash down onto your hands.

failure.text: You shift stone after stone and find nothing but dust.

success-by-5.text: You clear the heap down to the floor.

features.name: Cracked Cask
features.description: A wine cask split along its staves, long since dry.
features.discovery: A rag stuffed into the split hides nothing.

items.name: Silver Ring
items.description: A plain silver ring set with a chip of jet.

creatures.name: Cellar Cat
creatures.description: A one-eared cat watches you from the top step.

topics.name: the cask
topics.reply: The cat pads to the cracked cask and paws at the rag.
topics.failure: The cat yawns and looks away.

rooms.name: Rat Hole
rooms.description: A crawl space behind the cellar, its floor gnawed bones and straw.

passages.description: A gap low in the wall, behind a warped hatch.

door.name: Warped Hatch
door.description: A wooden hatch warped tight in its frame.

failure-by-5.text: The hatch springs back and cracks against your shin.

endings.title: Out with the ring
endings.text: You climb the steps into daylight with the silver ring.

endings.title: Out empty-handed
endings.text: You climb the steps into daylight with nothing to show for it.

endings.title: Buried in the cellar
endings.text: You fall among the cellar's stones. Your adventuring ends here.
